title: How to Safely Emergency Stop on the Highway
hook: Never pull over on highways like this.

script.narration: Never pull over on highways like this.
script.visual_search: dramatic car breaking down on busy highway at dusk

script.narration: Step one: Signal early and steer completely onto the right shoulder, far away from traffic. Step two: Turn on your hazard lights immediately so oncoming cars see you.
script.visual_search: car pulling over safely to highway shoulder hazard lights flashing

script.narration: Step three: Stay inside your vehicle with your seatbelt securely fastened while waiting for help.
script.visual_search: driver sitting safely inside car looking out side mirror

description:
Learn the 3 essential steps to pulling over safely on a busy highway during an emergency breakdown.

Following proper highway safety procedures protects you and prevents dangerous rear-end crashes. Save these steps for your next drive!
why_it_will_work: Leverages trending interest in highway traffic situations and safety while capitalizing on high-performing driving safety tips.
quality_problems: fact-check: Referring to traffic as 'oncoming cars' is inaccurate because vehicles approach from behind on a highway shoulder.; Instructing drivers to always stay inside the vehicle is misleading, as safety guidelines in many regions (such as the UK Highway Code) recommend exiting the car to wait behind a protective barrier if it is safe to do so.
